purpose: Reusable template and asset library so assets and brand kits can be swapped without rebuilding the project.

vision_qa.notes: Keep it in the plan; useful for frame-level QA before review.

telegram_workflow.notes: Footage goes directly into HyperFrames; no Telegram intake workflow.

spend_cap.rule: Keep it as low as possible while preserving best quality.

brand_kits.name: Reel Factory current kit
rules: Use lime only for keyword highlights, key numbers, CTA pills, and flash beats.
Use violet for fills, cards, icons, and secondary UI.
Use coral only for losses, warnings, and strikethroughs.
Flash beats are limited to 1-2 per reel and must be full-screen payoff moments.

template_slots.notes: Final card only; no persistent footer.
One FX to prove transitions work.
MediaPipe matte spike for the text-behind-subject test.
Reusable compare layout for before/after stories.

editorial_rules: Keep the JSON editable so assets and brand kits can be changed later.
Keep the task map active; nothing is stopped unless the user explicitly removes it.
Keep Telegram out of the workflow.
Keep spend minimal while preserving quality.
Treat Vision QA as approved later-stage work, not a blocker.
Use this library as the source of truth for V0 template slots, asset packs, and brand-kit values.
